notes.title: Part of You 1.1 Release!
notes.content:
[p][b]HOOOOOOOO WEEEE![/b]

It's been a long time coming, but welcome to 1.1! Does it have everything we wanted in it? No. Does it have a heck of a lot of cool new stuff?! Absolutely! 

1.1 brings a bunch of content that was cut from the initial release that we just didn't have time to finish up & lots & lots of bug fixes & optimization. So what does this update actually have?[/p][p][/p][h3][b]NO NEW CHARACTERS[/b][/h3][p]Is what we might have said if we were sane. Instead we have added 11 new characters and piles and piles of dialogue to the game. Like honestly, I am personally baffled why we keep doing this to ourselves. You might ask us, why would you add this amount of content to a game a year after it launched when nobody is playing it? Uhhhhh. Next question.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Achievements[/b][/h3][p]The original vision for the game had a lot more achievements and jokes we really couldn't cram into the initial release. This patch attempts to rectify that, adding a bunch of new achievements & interactions that really should have been there from the start. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Performance[/b][/h3][p]While our game does have Ray Tracing, it really should be able to run on just about anything. When the game first launched however, it required a super computer to play at a stable frame rate. One of the major focuses of this update was to really make sure our game could run on anything and we are a lot closer to that than we were before.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Future Stuff[/b][/h2][p]A couple of fun things to highlight with the release of 1.1.[/p][p][/p][p]We have been working on making the game more performant for a few reasons, but one of the biggest questions we were asked in the last year is:

[b]IS PART OF YOU STEAM DECK COMPATIBLE?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][strike]The short answer is yes[/strike]. While we aren't officially verified yet, it is something that is actively being worked on and we should have that squared away within a few weeks! It mostly works right now... mostly.[/p][p][/p][h3]Too Many Games[/h3][p]Are you in the Philadelphia area? Do you wanna come meet us, buy merch, or maybe just play the game at a con? That sounds dope to us! Come see us at TooManyGames June 27-29!
[url="https://toomanygames.com/"]https://toomanygames.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Indiepocalypse & Physical Release[/h3][p]With the release of 1.1 we are also sitting down with Andrew of Indiepocalypse to chat about indie games and whatever other weird stuff comes up. With this, Part of You will also be getting a physical release, something we are all stoked about. More news to come on this in the coming weeks.
[url="https://pizzapranks.com/"]https://pizzapranks.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Sale! [/h3][p]Do you wanna pick up Part of You on discount? Now (might be a few hours from now) through early July, the game is going to be on sale for 10$, so make sure to pickup a copy for a friend![/p][p][/p][p]That's all from us for now, but I'm sure there will be more soon!

Till then, you can always come hang out with us on discord or report your game breaking bugs and watch me mentally fall apart in real time. It's a lot of fun! 
[url="https://discord.gg/5WSzqbsT9e"]https://discord.gg/5WSzqbsT9e[/url]

A very special thank you to our community for being patient the last few months as we put this update together. We love you all and cannot wait for y'all to see the new stuff we have added!
[/p]
